title: Running Commentary on Torah 15 — Mi she'Rotzeh Li't'om Ta'am Or Ha'Ganuz
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 15 — מי שרוצה לטעום טעם אור הגנוז
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"Leshon Rabbeinu, zichrono li'vracha"** — Rabbeinu's own voice.

**"V'atem tihyu li mamleches kohanim v'goy kadosh"** (Shemos 19:6) — the opening pasuk, decoded at end: **mamleches = Torah shebe'niglah; kohanim = tefilah; goy kadosh = sisrei oraysa (bes ha'Mikdash)**; means of access = **elevating yirah via mishpat to da'as**.

intermediate.en: **"V'atem tihyu li mamleches kohanim v'goy kadosh"** (Shem 19:6). Decoded: **mamleches=niglah; kohanim=tefilah; goy kadosh=sisrei oraysa**; access via **yirah→mishpat→da'as**.
intermediate.he: **"ואתם תהיו לי ממלכת כהנים וגוי קדוש"** (שמ' יט, ו). פענוח: **ממלכת=נגלה; כהנים=תפילה; גוי קדוש=סתרי אורייתא**; דרך הגישה: **יראה→משפט→דעת**.

beginner.en: **"א. Mi she'rotzeh lit'om ta'am or ha'ganuz — i.e., the sodos ha'Torah that will be revealed l'asid — must raise midas ha'yirah to its shoresh."**

intermediate.en: **א. To taste or ha'ganuz / sodos l'asid → raise yirah to its shoresh.**
intermediate.he: **א. לטעום אור הגנוז / סודות לעתיד → להעלות יראה לשורשה.**

scholarly.he: סעיף א. טעם אור הגנוז = העלאת יראה.

beginner.en: **"By what does one raise yirah? By **mishpat** — 'melech b'mishpat ya'amid aretz' (Mishlei 29:4), and **aretz = yirah** — 'eretz yarah' (Tehillim 76:9). I.e., **judge all your matters yourself**: 'y'chalkel devarav b'mishpat' (Tehillim 112:5) — judge and weigh your own affairs. Through this, all pachadim fall away and bare **yiras Hashem** remains, with no other fear mixed in."** **"When a person does not judge himself, they judge him **above** — **'im ein din l'matah, yesh din l'ma'alah'** (Devarim Rabbah 5:4). When judged above, the din clothes itself in all things, and all things become Hashem's messengers to execute the din on him — Chazal (Nedarim 41a on **'l'mishpatecha amdu, ki ha'kol avadecha'**): when there is din above, all are Hashem's servants to enact the judgment. But when he judges himself below — no din above — and yirah doesn't clothe itself in any thing to stir him, because he stirs himself."** **"'V'sam derech' (Tehillim 50:23) = one who **places his ways** (**sam orchos**; as Chazal expound, Sotah 5b) — judges his ways — as **'v'eileh ha'mishpatim asher tasim'** (Shemos 21:1; Bereshis Rabbah Mishpatim 30) — then **'ar'enu b'yesha Elokim'** = bechina of **yirah** ('es ha'Elokim yera,' Kohelet 12:13). I.e., yirah **rises from the klipah** and **from the umos** via mishpat — for first it was clothed in the klipah."** **"When a person fears something — an official, thieves, etc. — yirah clothed itself in that thing; without the yirah-clothing, the thing would have no power to frighten."**

intermediate.en: **How to raise yirah: mishpat** ("melech b'mishpat," Mishlei 29:4; aretz=yirah, Teh 76:9 "eretz yarah"; "y'chalkel devarav b'mishpat," Teh 112:5). Judge yourself → din doesn't clothe in external things. **"Im ein din l'matah, yesh din l'ma'alah"** (DR 5:4; Ned 41a "l'mishpatecha amdu... ha'kol avadecha"). **"V'sam derech"** (Teh 50:23; Sotah 5b)=placing ways="v'eileh ha'mishpatim asher tasim" (Shem 21:1; BR Mishpatim 30) → **"ar'enu b'yesha Elokim"**=yirah (Koh 12:13). Yirah rises from klipah/umos. Frights=yirah clothed in objects.
intermediate.he: **איך מעלים יראה: משפט** ("מלך במשפט", מש' כט, ד; ארץ=יראה, תה' עו, ט "ארץ יראה"; "יכלכל דבריו במשפט", תה' קיב, ה). לשפוט עצמך → הדין לא מתלבש בחיצוניים. **"אם אין דין למטה, יש דין למעלה"** (דב"ר ה, ד; נד' מא. "למשפטיך עמדו... הכל עבדיך"). **"ושם דרך"** (תה' נ, כג; סוטה ה:)=שם אורחותיו="ואלה המשפטים אשר תשים" (שמ' כא, א; ב"ר משפטים ל) → **"אראנו בישע אלוקים"**=יראה (קה' יב, יג). יראה עולה מהקליפה/אומות. פחדים=יראה מתלבשת בדברים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. משפט: מש' כט, ד; תה' עו, ט; קיב, ה; דב"ר ה, ד; נד' מא.; תה' נ, כג (סוטה ה:); שמ' כא, א (ב"ר משפטים ל); קה' יב, יג. יראה בקליפה.

beginner.en: **"**Shoresh ha'yirah = da'as** — as in Etz Chaim: **manzp"ch is in da'as of Ze'ir Anpin** — **'az tavin yiras Hashem v'da'as Elokim timtza'** (Mishlei 2:5). The essential da'as is in the **lev** — **'v'lo nasan Hashem lachem lev la'da'as'** (Devarim 29:3). There too is essential yirah — Chazal (Kiddushin 32b): **davar ha'masur la'lev, ne'emar bo 'v'yareta m'Elokecha'** — i.e., **knowing whom to fear** — yiras **Hashem ha'nichbad, yiras ha'romemus** (see below Torah 154)."**

intermediate.en: **Shoresh yirah = da'as** (Etz Chaim: manzp"ch in da'as d'Z"A; Mishlei 2:5 "az tavin yiras Hashem v'da'as"). Da'as in **lev** ("v'lo nasan Hashem lachem lev la'da'as," Dev 29:3); yirah too (Kid 32b "davar ha'masur la'lev...v'yareta") — **yiras ha'romemus** (see Tor 154).
intermediate.he: **שורש יראה = דעת** (עץ חיים: מנצפ"ך בדעת דז"א; מש' ב, ה "אז תבין יראת ה' ודעת"). דעת ב**לב** ("ולא נתן ה' לכם לב לדעת", דב' כט, ג); גם יראה (קיד' לב: "דבר המסור ללב... ויראת") — **יראת הרוממות** (עיין תורה קנד).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. שורש יראה=דעת (עה"ח; מש' ב, ה); דעת בלב (דב' כט, ג; קיד' לב:).

beginner.en: **"ד. When one reaches da'as, he merits **hasagas ha'Torah** — 'ani chochmah shachanti ormah' (Mishlei 8:12) — Torah dwells with a **bar da'as**; 'Kudsha Brich Hu yahiv chochmesa l'chakimin' (Daniel 2:21). But there are **2 bechinos of Torah**: **niglah** and **nistar**. Nistar is only merited **l'asid la'vo**; in this world one merits nistar only via **tefilah b'mesiras nefesh**; and one merits tefilah via **Torah she'be'niglah**."** **"Torah she'be'niglah = bechina of **Sinai** — Chazal (Berachos 64a): **'Sinai v'oker harim, hei'na minayhu adif?'** Answer: **'Sinai adif, ki ha'kol tzrichin l'mari chitaya'** ('everyone needs the baal of the wheat') — niglah everyone needs; nistar — only a few need. **Sinai = shiflus** — Chazal (Sotah 5a): HKBH left all the mountains and gave the Torah only on Sinai. Chazal (Sotah 5b): **'tefilas ha'shafel einah nim'eses'** — 'lev nishbar' (Tehillim 51:19). Via **tefilah b'mesiras nefesh** — nullifying all gashmiyus — no gvul — he grasps the Torah of l'asid which is **beyond any gvul**."**

intermediate.en: **ד. Da'as → hasagas ha'Torah** (Mishlei 8:12; Dan 2:21). **2 Torahs**: niglah + nistar. Nistar l'asid; in this world only via **tefilah b'mesiras nefesh**. Tefilah via **niglah=Sinai** (Ber 64a "Sinai v'oker harim — Sinai adif, ha'kol tzrichin l'mari chitaya"; Sot 5a mountains). **Sinai=shiflus**; **"tefilas ha'shafel einah nim'eses"** (Sot 5b; Teh 51:19 "lev nishbar"). **Mesiras nefesh=no gvul → grasp of Torah of l'asid**.
intermediate.he: **ד. דעת → השגת תורה** (מש' ח, יב; דנ' ב, כא). **ב' תורות**: נגלה + נסתר. נסתר לעתיד; בעוה"ז רק ע"י **תפילה במסירת נפש**. תפילה ע"י **נגלה=סיני** (בר' סד. "סיני ועוקר הרים — סיני עדיף, הכל צריכין למרי חטיא"; סוטה ה. הרים). **סיני=שפלות**; **"תפילת השפל אינה נמאסת"** (סוטה ה:; תה' נא, יט "לב נשבר"). **מסירת נפש=אין גבול → השגת תורה דלעתיד**.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. ב' תורות — נגלה (סיני; בר' סד.; סוטה ה.) ונסתר (לעתיד; במס"נ). שפלות (סוטה ה:; תה' נא, יט). אין גבול = תורת לעתיד.

beginner.en: **The ma'amar.** **"Amar Rabba bar bar Chana: **'Li'didi chazei li ha'hi akrukta, d'havi ki akra d'Hagronia. V'akra d'Hagronia kama havi? Shitin batei. Asa tanina bal'ah. Asa pushkantza u'bla'ah l'tanina, v'salik yasiv b'ilana. Ta chazei kama nafish cheila d'ilana. Amar Rav Papa bar Shmuel: i lav d'havi hasam lo heimani.'"** — 'I saw with my own eyes a **frog (akrukta)** the size of the city of Hagronia. (And Hagronia — how big was it? 60 houses.) A **sea-serpent (tanina)** came and swallowed it. A **female raven (pushkantza)** came and swallowed the serpent, and flew up and sat in a tree. Come see how great the tree's strength! R' Papa bar Shmuel said: had I not been there, I wouldn't have believed it.' (Bava Basra 73b.)

intermediate.en: **BB 73b — 12th ma'amar**: **akrukta**=frog size of Hagronia (60 houses); **tanina** swallowed; **pushkantza** (female raven) swallowed tanina, flew up to **ilana** (tree). R' Papa bar Shmuel: "i lav d'havi hasam lo heimani."
intermediate.he: **ב"ב עג: — י"ב מרבב"ח**: **אקרוקתא**=צפרדע בגודל הגרוניא (ס' בתים); **תנינא** בלעה; **פושקנצא** (עורב נקבה) בלעה את התנינא, עלה ל**אילנא**. ר' פפא בר שמואל: "אי לאו דהוי התם לא הימני".

beginner.en: **Rashbam**: **akrukta** = frog. **K'akra d'Hagronia** = as big as that city. **60 batei** is the Talmud's; **asa tanina** is Rabba's. **Pushkantza** = female raven. **B'ilana** = on a branch, as is the way of birds. **Lo heimani** = I would not have believed.

intermediate.en: Rashbam: **akrukta**=frog; **akra d'Hagronia**=city; **60 batei**=Talmud; **pushkantza**=female raven; **ilana**=branch; **lo heimani**=not believed.
intermediate.he: רשב"ם: **אקרוקתא**=צפרדע; **אקרא דהגרוניא**=כרך; **ס' בתי**=תלמודא; **פושקנצא**=עורב נקבה; **אילנא**=ענף; **לא הימני**=לא האמין.

beginner.en: **The Rebbe's peirush.** **"**Akrukta** = frog (Rashbam). Bechina of **aliyas ha'yirah to its shoresh = da'as** — because **tzfardei'a = murkav** — **tzafar de'ah** (Tana d'Bei Eliyahu 7; Kavanos Haggadah). **Tzippor = yirah = aretz** ('mi'knaf ha'aretz zemiros,' Yeshayahu 24:16; 'mi eleh' = letters of **Elokim** — 'ka'av te'ufenah,' Yeshayahu 60:8). **De'ah = shoresh ha'yirah**."** **"**Akra d'Hagronia** — lashon of **'kra b'garon'** (Yeshayahu 58:1) — **Torah she'be'niglah** — as Chazal (Eruvin 54a): **'l'motzi'eihem ba'peh'** — since via raising yirah to da'as one merits niglah."** **"**60 batei** = bechina of **tefilah**. When we call HKBH by **toarim of flesh and blood** and He is found to us in every call — this is Hashem's chesed. Were it not by Hashem's chesed, it would be unworthy to call Him with titles, praises, words, and letters. **60 batei** = **chesed = Avraham** — 'shishim heimah malachos' (Shir 6:8), Rashi: 'this is bechina of Avraham'; 'batei' = lashon of **batei malchus** (Sotah 11b; Rashi Shemos 1:19). **'Samchuni ba'ashishos'** (Shir 2:5) — as one places *ashishos* (glass lenses) before great light to be able to look through them — so He decreed His chesed to **support us** with these titles and praises. **'Samchuni' = lashon of **samech** = 60 malchuyos = Avraham = **samech batei**."** **"**Asa tanina u'bla'ah** — **tanina = nachash** — seducing one to pray **l'to'eles atzmo** — 'hav lana chayei u'mezona' or other selfish needs."** **"**Asa pushkantza u'bla'ah** — Rashbam: raven. Chazal (Eruvin 22a): **'mi she'mashchir panav ka'orev, u'mi she'naasah achzari al banav ka'orev'** — i.e., one who prays with no self-interest kavanah, considers himself nothing, nullifies his entire atzmus v'gashmiyus as if he is not in the world — **'ki alecha horagnu kol ha'yom'** (Tehillim 44:23). Bechina of **'sh'choros ka'orev'** (Shir 5:11)."** **"Through this **'salik yasiv b'ilana'** — merits **sisrei Torah** — 'yasheis choshech sisro' (Tehillim 18:12) — **sisrei Torah via **choshech = mesiras nefesh**, blackening his face like the raven, bechina of choshech = omek ha'hasagah."** **"**B'ilana** — where neshamos dwell — Zohar Mishpatim 99a: **'kol nishmasin mei'ilana rav'rva nafkin'**. **Olam ha'ba** = arichus yamim — 'ki'mei eitz yemei ami' (Yeshayahu 65:22)."** **"This is merited via tefilah — HKBH **craves** Yisrael's tefilos (Chullin 60b). When Yisrael pray and fulfill His craving, k'viyachol He becomes bechina of **ishah** (receiving ta'anug) — 'ishei rei'ach nicho'ach la'Hashem' (Bamidbar 28:2); **'u'nekevah tesovev gaver'** (Yirmiyahu 31:21) — HKBH becomes, bi'bechina, a **revealed garment**: what was previously nistar is now **niglah via tefilah**. **Kudsha Brich Hu v'Oraysa chad**; thus by tefilah oraysa is revealed = **sisrei oraysa**."** **"**Ta chazei kama nafish cheila d'ilana** — how great the strength of sisrei Torah: cannot clothe itself in any bounded thing/body, only one who blackens his face like the raven and becomes like the raven to its young."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **Akrukta**=**tzippor-de'ah** (Tana d'Bei Eliyahu 7; Kavanos Hagg) — **yirah raised to da'as**. Tzippor=yirah=aretz (Yesh 24:16; 60:8). **Akra d'Hagronia**="kra b'garon" (Yesh 58:1)=niglah (Eruvin 54a). **60 batei**=tefilah; chesed=Avraham=shishim malchus (Shir 6:8 Rashi); "samchuni ba'ashishos" (Shir 2:5)=samech=60 batei. **Tanina**=nachash — selfish tefilah. **Pushkantza**=raven=mesiras nefesh (Eruvin 22a "mashchir panav"/"achzari al banav"; Teh 44:23; Shir 5:11). **Salik b'ilana**=sisrei Torah (Teh 18:12 "yasheis choshech"); neshamos-tree (Zohar Mishpatim 99a); olam ha'ba (Yesh 65:22). HKBH craves tefilah (Chul 60b) → ishah (Bam 28:2 rei'ach nichoach; Yir 31:21 "nekevah tesovev") → oraysa revealed.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **אקרוקתא**=**ציפור-דעה** (תד"א ז'; כוונות ההגדה) — **יראה שהועלתה לדעת**. ציפור=יראה=ארץ (יש' כד, טז; ס, ח). **אקרא דהגרוניא**="קרא בגרון" (יש' נח, א)=נגלה (עירו' נד.). **ס' בתי**=תפילה; חסד=אברהם=ששים מלכות (שה"ש ו, ח רש"י); "סמכוני באשישות" (שה"ש ב, ה)=סמ"ך=ס' בתי. **תנינא**=נחש — תפילה לתועלת עצמו. **פושקנצא**=עורב=מסירת נפש (עירו' כב. "משחיר פניו"/"אכזרי על בניו"; תה' מד, כג; שה"ש ה, יא). **סליק באילנא**=סתרי תורה (תה' יח, יב "ישת חושך"); אילן הנשמות (זוה"ק משפטים צט.); עוה"ב (יש' סה, כב). הקב"ה מתאווה לתפילה (חול' ס:) → אשה (במ' כח, ב ריח ניחוח; יר' לא, כא "נקבה תסובב") → אורייתא נתגלית.

scholarly.he: פירוש: אקרוקתא=צפר דעה (תד"א ז'); יש' כד, טז; ס, ח. אקרא דהגרוניא=קרא בגרון (יש' נח, א; עירו' נד.). ס' בתי=אברהם (שה"ש ו, ח; סוטה יא:; רש"י שמ' א, יט); סמכוני (שה"ש ב, ה)=סמ"ך. תנינא=נחש/תועלת עצמו. פושקנצא=עורב/מס"נ (עירו' כב.; תה' מד, כג; שה"ש ה, יא). אילנא=סתרים/נשמות (תה' יח, יב; זוה"ק משפטים צט.; יש' סה, כב). תפילה→ריח ניחוח→גילוי אורייתא (חול' ס:; במ' כח, ב; יר' לא, כא).

beginner.en: **"This is bechina of **5 kinyanim shek'naneh HKBH ba'olamo** (Avos 6:10)."** **"'Torah kinyan echad' = niglah."** **"'Shamayim v'aretz kinyan echad' = aliyas ha'yirah l'da'as. **Aretz = yirah**; **shamayim = da'as** — da'as is **chibbur** (union): 'v'ha'adam yada' (Bereshis 4:1). Shamayim = esh + mayim joined (Chagigah 12a; Bereshis Rabbah 4:6) = da'as."** **"'Avraham kinyan echad' = tefilah = shitin batei = shishim heimah malchuyos."** **"'Yisrael kinyan echad' = mishpat raising yirah — 'chukav u'mishpatav l'Yisrael' (Tehillim 147:19)."** **"'Beis ha'Mikdash kinyan echad' = sisrei oraysa, merited via tefilah = Avraham. 'Har zeh kansah y'mino' (Tehillim 78:54) — yamin = tefilah = Avraham. Called **har** for **omek ha'hasagah**. Called **Beis ha'Mikdash** = bechina of **kodesh = reishis**; 'v'chol zar lo yochal kodesh' (Vayikra 22:10) — only its **m'kudashav u'mikra'av** — the BH"M = sisrei oraysa."**

intermediate.en: **5 kinyanim** (Avos 6:10): **Torah**=niglah; **Shamayim+aretz**=da'as+yirah (aretz=yirah; shamayim=esh+mayim=da'as, Chag 12a; BR 4:6; Ber 4:1 "yada"); **Avraham**=tefilah=60 batei/malchuyos; **Yisrael**=mishpat (Teh 147:19); **BH"M**=sisrei oraysa (Teh 78:54 "har zeh kansah y'mino"; har=omek; Vay 22:10 "v'chol zar").
intermediate.he: **ה' קנינים** (אבות ו, י): **תורה**=נגלה; **שמים+ארץ**=דעת+יראה (ארץ=יראה; שמים=אש+מים=דעת, חג' יב.; ב"ר ד, ו; בר' ד, א "ידע"); **אברהם**=תפילה=ס' בתים/מלכות; **ישראל**=משפט (תה' קמז, יט); **בהמ"ק**=סתרי אורייתא (תה' עח, נד "הר זה קנתה ימינו"; הר=עומק; ויק' כב, י "וכל זר").

scholarly.he: ה' קנינים (אבות ו, י): תורה/שמים+ארץ/אברהם/ישראל/בהמ"ק = נגלה/דעת+יראה/תפילה/משפט/סתרים. חג' יב.; ב"ר ד, ו; תה' קמז, יט; עח, נד; ויק' כב, י.

beginner.en: **"ז. The peirush of the pasuk:** **'V'atem tihyu li mamleches kohanim' — **mamleches = niglah** — 'bi melachim yimlochu' (Mishlei 8:15); malchus is niglah, 'ein melech b'lo am' — all need the melech (= 'mari chitaya'). **Kohanim = tefilah = Avraham** — Chazal (Nedarim 32b): HKBH said to Avraham, 'atah kohen l'olam.' **Goy kadosh = BH"M = sisrei Torah**, called **kodesh**."** **"By what does one merit these bechinos? By **raising and binding yirah to da'as via mishpat**."** **"**Eileh ha'devarim asher tedaber** — **yirah is called 'davar'** — essence of dibbur is there (Berachos 6b: 'mi she'yesh bo yiras shamayim, devarav nishma'im'). **Moshe = da'as** — 'asher tedaber' dayka. 'Ki yihyeh lahem davar ba elai' (Shemos 18:16) = Yisrael (=mishpat) raising and binding yirah to **Moshe = da'as**. **El bnei Yisrael** — dayka — they are bechina of mishpat ('chukav u'mishpatav l'Yisrael'). Thus: binding yirah to da'as via mishpat → merit niglah → merit tefilah → merit sisrei oraysa."** **"'Davar' = yirah — 'az nidbaru yir'ei Hashem' (Mal'achi 3:16)."**

intermediate.en: **ז. Pasuk**: **Mamleches**=niglah (Mishlei 8:15 "bi melachim"); **kohanim**=tefilah=Avraham (Ned 32b); **goy kadosh**=BH"M=sisrei Torah. **Eileh ha'devarim asher tedaber**: **davar=yirah** (Ber 6b "yiras shamayim — devarav nishma'im"; Mal 3:16); **tedaber**=**Moshe=da'as**; **Yisrael=mishpat** (Teh 147:19). Chain: mishpat→yirah+da'as→niglah→tefilah→sisrei oraysa.
intermediate.he: **ז. הפסוק**: **ממלכת**=נגלה (מש' ח, טו "בי מלכים"); **כהנים**=תפילה=אברהם (נד' לב:); **גוי קדוש**=בהמ"ק=סתרי תורה. **אלה הדברים אשר תדבר**: **דבר=יראה** (בר' ו: "יראת שמים — דבריו נשמעים"; מל' ג, טז); **תדבר**=**משה=דעת**; **ישראל=משפט** (תה' קמז, יט). שרשרת: משפט→יראה+דעת→נגלה→תפילה→סתרי אורייתא.

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. ממלכת=נגלה (מש' ח, טו); כהנים=תפילה=אברהם (נד' לב:); גוי קדוש=סתרי. דבר=יראה (בר' ו:; מל' ג, טז); משה=דעת. שרשרת.

beginner.en: **"This Torah also belongs to** Tehillim 101:6 — **'einai b'ne'emnei aretz la'sheves imadi, holech b'derech tamim hu y'sharseni.'** **Einai = da'as** — 'va'tipakachnah einei shneihem' (Bereshis 3:7); da'as = 10 Shemos Havayah = gematria 2×eye (as known). **B'ne'emnei = Aharon** (Midrash Shocher Tov) = **mishpat** — 'v'nasa Aharon es mishpat b'nei Yisrael' (Shemos 28:30). **Aretz = yirah**. **La'sheves imadi = Sinai = shiflus** — 'eshkon es daka' (Yeshayahu 57:15). **Holech b'derech tamim = tefilah = Avraham** — 'his'halech l'fanai v'heyeh tamim' (Bereshis 17:1). **Hu y'sharseni = sisrei oraysa = bechina of **hu** = olam ha'ba** (Zohar Vayetze 154b; 158b)."**

intermediate.en: **Tehillim 101:6**: **einai**=da'as (Ber 3:7 "va'tipakachnah"; gematria 2 ayin); **b'ne'emnei**=Aharon=mishpat (Shocher Tov; Shem 28:30); **aretz**=yirah; **la'sheves imadi**=Sinai/shiflus (Yesh 57:15); **holech b'derech tamim**=Avraham/tefilah (Ber 17:1); **hu y'sharseni**=sisrei oraysa/olam ha'ba (Zohar Vayetze 154b; 158b).
intermediate.he: **תה' קא, ו**: **עיני**=דעת (בר' ג, ז "ותפקחנה"; גימ' ב' עין); **בנאמני**=אהרן=משפט (שוח"ט; שמ' כח, ל); **ארץ**=יראה; **לשבת עמדי**=סיני/שפלות (יש' נז, טו); **הולך בדרך תמים**=אברהם/תפילה (בר' יז, א); **הוא ישרתני**=סתרי אורייתא/עוה"ב (זוה"ק ויצא קנד:; קנח:).

scholarly.he: תה' קא, ו: עיני=דעת; בנאמני=אהרן/משפט (שוח"ט; שמ' כח, ל); ארץ=יראה; לשבת=סיני/שפלות (יש' נז, טו); תמים=אברהם (בר' יז, א); הוא=עוה"ב (זוה"ק ויצא קנד:; קנח:).

beginner.en: **Closing doxology** (Reb Nosson or editor): **"Baruch ha'bocher b'adas mi manah, asher ad koh azrenu li'shmo'a pla'os ka'eileh al ma'amarei Rabba bar bar Chana. Ta chazei kama nafish cheila d'ha'i ilana. Ke'an bi'rshusa d'Malka ila'ah, kadmeichon yasik lit'mida imrei ya'ei, rav tov ha'tzafun v'ganuz b'ma'amarin kadishin d'aryavasa d'vei ila'ah, inun matzdei chakla d'havu mishta'i, d'b'hon genizin eitin kadishin d'nafkin me'Oraysa d'Atika Stima'a. Lechu chazu mif'alos Hashem, darko nifla'ah, rabah ilana v'takif, v'rumah mata l'tzeis shma'ya, v'chazusa l'sof kol ar'a, inbah sagi v'chazveih ya'ei. Shim'u u'techi nafshechem, u'she'avtem mayim b'sason mi'ma'ayanei ha'yeshu'ah."** — 'Blessed be He who chose the congregation of 'Who has counted?' who has helped us till now to hear such wonders on the sayings of Rabba bar bar Chana. Come see how great the strength of this tree. Now, by permission of the supernal King, there shall rise before you **imrei ya'ei** (pleasing words) — the great good stored and hidden in the holy teachings of the lions of the supernal house, those **matzdei chakla** (reapers of the field) who spoke — wherein are stored holy counsels going forth from Oraysa of Atika Stima'a. Go and see Hashem's works — wondrous His way. Great is the tree and mighty; its height reaches the host of heaven, and its appearance to the end of all the earth; its fruit abundant, its appearance pleasing. Hear and your souls shall live, and you shall draw water with joy from the wellsprings of salvation.'

intermediate.en: Closing doxology: gratitude to HKBH for hearing wonders on RbbH; introduces further teachings as **matzdei chakla** reaping from **Oraysa d'Atika Stima'a**. Tree's greatness; "shim'u u'techi nafshechem, u'she'avtem mayim b'sason."
intermediate.he: חתימת דוכסיולוגיה: תודה לה' על שמיעת הפלאות ברבב"ח; מקדים המשך בתור **מחצדי חקלא** קוצרים מ**אורייתא דעתיקא סתימאה**. גודל האילן; "שמעו ותחי נפשכם, ושאבתם מים בששון".

scholarly.he: חתימה: ברוך הבוחר... מחצדי חקלא / אורייתא דעתיקא סתימאה.
